Articles, conference papers, and theses that used eeguana, newest first. If yours is missing, please [open an issue](https://github.com/bnicenboim/eeguana/issues) or send a pull request that adds it to `vignettes/papers.bib`.

To cite eeguana itself, see `citation("eeguana")`.
